pricing_text: For 5s video your request will cost **$0.15** for 540p, **$0.30** for 720p and **$1.20** for 1080p. 10s is not available for image-to-video (start-frame requirement). HDR (5s) costs **$0.60** at 720p and **$2.40** at 1080p; HDR + EXR (5s) costs **$0.90** at 720p and **$3.60** at 1080p (540p not available in HDR). For **$1** you can run this model approximately **6 times** (540p/5s).
notes: السعر لمقطع كامل 5 ث (الوحدة clip) حسب الدقة؛ usd للافتراضي والأرخص (540p). 10 ث غير متاح مع image_url مفرد (يتطلب keyframes). HDR (5 ث): 720p $0.60، 1080p $2.40؛ HDR+EXR: 720p $0.90، 1080p $3.60.
